# SinapsAI — Comprehensive Technical Specification & Full LLM Reference (llms-full.txt)

> **Version**: 2.12.0  
> **Author**: Roedy Rustam <roedyrustam.id@gmail.com>  
> **Copyright**: 2026 Roedy Rustam. All Rights Reserved.  
> **License**: MIT  
> **Repository**: https://github.com/roedyrustam/sinapsai  
> **Package**: `npm install sinapsai`

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Design Invariants

SinapsAI is a universal, zero-runtime-dependency, in-process AI Gateway and Control Plane for TypeScript, Node.js (18+), Bun (1.0+), Deno (2.x), and Edge runtimes (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge).

### Invariants:
1. **Zero External Runtime Dependencies**: 100% written with native Web Standards (`fetch`, `AbortController`, `EventSource` SSE, Web Streams, Web Crypto).
2. **Sub-5ms Execution Overhead**: In-memory routing, circuit breaker evaluation, guardrail scanning, and token estimation execute with <5ms overhead (<0.5ms for cache hits).
3. **100% In-Process Privacy**: No payloads, system prompts, API keys, or telemetry data are ever routed through external third-party telemetry servers.
4. **Resilience by Default**: Built-in automated failover, hierarchical model-level fallback chains, exponential retries with jitter, and speculative hedged requests to crush P99 tail latencies.
5. **Universal Standardization**: Connects to 10 major LLM providers using standard OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions, Embeddings, and Function Calling format.

---

## 2. System Architecture

```
[ Your Application / Agent ]
             │
             ▼
  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │              SinapsClient (Control Plane)              │
  ├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ 1. SecurityGuardrails (Injection, Jailbreak, ReDoS)    │
  │ 2. PIIGuardrails (Reversible Tokenization Vault)       │
  │ 3. ContextCompressor (Sliding-Window / Middle-Out)     │
  │ 4. LlmOptimizer (LLMO: Minify, KV-Cache, Cascade)      │
  │ 5. GatewayRateLimiter (Sliding Window RPM / TPM)       │
  │ 6. Model Alias Resolver (Virtual Names -> Target ID)   │
  └──────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────┘
                             │
                             ▼
  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │                 Router & Resilience                    │
  ├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ • Multi-Strategy Dynamic Routing:                      │
  │   - 'adaptive' / 'smart-hybrid'                        │
  │   - 'lowest-cost' (Dual-pricing prompt vs completion)  │
  │   - 'lowest-latency' (Moving average latency)          │
  │   - 'load-balance' (Round-robin)                       │
  │   - 'failover' (Priority order)                        │
  │ • In-Process CircuitBreaker (CLOSED, OPEN, HALF_OPEN)  │
  │ • Speculative HedgedExecutor (Delay-based backup calls)│
  │ • Semantic & Exact Prompt Caches                       │
  │ • BudgetGuardrails (FinOps USD & Token Caps)           │
  └──────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────┘
                             │
            ┌────────────────┴────────────────┐
            ▼                                 ▼
   [ Native Providers ]              [ Advanced Modules ]
   - OpenAI                          - McpToolBridge (MCP JSON-RPC)
   - Anthropic Claude                - AgentSwarm & A2A Handoff
   - Google Gemini                   - GeminiAgentBooster
   - DeepSeek                        - sinapsai/ai-sdk Adapter
   - Groq LPU                        - OpenTelemetry / Prometheus
   - OpenRouter
   - Mistral AI
   - Ollama Local
   - xAI Grok
   - Cohere v2
```

## 3. Core API Reference

### 3.1 Initializing `SinapsClient`

```typescript
import {
  SinapsClient,
  OpenAiProvider,
  AnthropicProvider,
  GeminiProvider,
  GroqProvider,
  DeepSeekProvider,
  XAiProvider,
  CohereProvider,
  MistralProvider,
  OllamaProvider,
  OpenRouterProvider,
  InMemoryStorage,
  CloudflareKVStorage,
  D1Storage,
  RedisStorage,
} from 'sinapsai';

const client = new SinapsClient({
  // Routing strategy: 'adaptive' | 'lowest-cost' | 'lowest-latency' | 'failover' | 'load-balance'
  strategy: 'adaptive',

  // Providers registered in order
  providers: [
    new GeminiProvider({
      apiKey: process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY!,
      defaultModel: 'gemini-2.5-flash',
    }),
    new OpenAiProvider({
      apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY!,
      defaultModel: 'gpt-4o-mini',
    }),
    new AnthropicProvider({
      apiKey: process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY!,
      defaultModel: 'claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219',
      promptCaching: 'auto', // Inject ephemeral cache breakpoints
    }),
    new GroqProvider({
      apiKey: process.env.GROQ_API_KEY!,
      defaultModel: 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile',
    }),
  ],

  // 1. In-Process Circuit Breaker
  circuitBreaker: {
    failureThreshold: 3,
    resetTimeoutMs: 30000,
    recoverySuccessThreshold: 2,
  },

  // 2. Speculative Hedging for Tail Latency (P99)
  hedging: {
    enabled: true,
    delayMs: 250, // Fire backup after 250ms
  },

  // 3. Universal LLM Optimization Engine (LLMO)
  llmo: {
    enabled: true,
    minifyPrompts: true,           // Strip whitespace preserving code blocks
    deduplicateSystem: true,       // Merge repeated system instructions
    alignKvCachePrefix: true,      // Canonicalize tool & JSON schemas
    autoCascadeModel: true,        // Dynamic model escalation based on complexity
    cascadeTiers: {
      tier1: 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite',
      tier2: 'gemini-2.5-flash',
      tier3: 'gemini-2.5-pro',
    },
    dynamicThinking: true,         // Allocate auto thinking budgets
  },

  // 4. In-Process Security & Prompt Injection Defense
  securityGuardrails: {
    enabled: true,
    action: 'block', // 'block' | 'sanitize' | 'warn'
  },

  // 5. In-Process PII Guardrails with Reversible Tokenization Vault
  piiGuardrails: {
    enabled: true,
    reversible: true, // Automatically restores real PII in responses
  },

  // 6. Sliding-Window Gateway Rate Limiting (RPM / TPM)
  rateLimiting: {
    defaultRule: {
      requestsPerMinute: 600,
      tokensPerMinute: 200000,
    },
    modelRules: {
      'gemini-2.5-pro': { requestsPerMinute: 60 },
    },
  },

  // 7. FinOps Spend & Token Limits
  budget: {
    maxCostUsd: 50.0,
    maxTotalTokens: 5000000,
    action: 'block', // Throws BudgetExceededError
  },

  // 8. Context Compression
  contextCompression: {
    maxPromptTokens: 8192,
    strategy: 'sliding-window', // 'sliding-window' | 'middle-out'
  },

  // 9. Model Aliases
  modelAliases: {
    fast: 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite',
    smart: 'claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219',
    cheap: 'groq/llama-3.3-70b-versatile',
  },
});
```

### 3.2 Chat Completions (Non-Streaming)

```typescript
const response = await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: 'auto', // LLMO dynamically selects optimal model tier
  messages: [
    { role: 'system', content: 'You are an expert engineer.' },
    { role: 'user', content: 'What is consensus in distributed computing?' },
  ],
  temperature: 0.2,
  thinkingBudget: 'auto', // Universal reasoning allocation
});

console.log(response.choices[0].message.content);
console.log('Provider used:', response.provider);
console.log('Usage:', response.usage);
```

### 3.3 Chat Completions (Streaming SSE)

```typescript
const stream = await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: 'fast',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Stream an explanation of Paxos.' }],
  stream: true,
});

for await (const chunk of stream) {
  const delta = chunk.choices[0]?.delta?.content || '';
  process.stdout.write(delta);
  if (chunk.choices[0]?.delta?.reasoning_content) {
    process.stderr.write(`[Thinking]: ${chunk.choices[0].delta.reasoning_content}`);
  }
}
```

---

## 4. Universal LLM Optimization Engine (LLMO)

SinapsAI includes a first-class, zero-dependency LLM Optimization Engine (`LlmOptimizer`) accessible via `client.llmo`, `client.optimizePrompt()`, or configured directly via `options.llmo`.

### 4.1 Features & Capabilities:
1. **Code-Block Aware Prompt Minification**:
   - Removes redundant multiple spaces, horizontal tabs, and line-trailing whitespace in prose.
   - Preserves code blocks (````` ``` ... ``` ````) 100% verbatim, keeping indentation and syntax intact.
   - Collapses 3+ consecutive newlines to 2, maintaining clear markdown paragraphs.
   - Two modes: `'lossless'` (zero semantic alteration) and `'aggressive'` (strips conversational fluff like "could you please help me to").
2. **System Instruction Deduplication**:
   - Merges multiple system messages across conversational history, stripping redundant rule statements.
3. **Deterministic KV-Cache Prefix Alignment**:
   - Lexicographically sorts tool definitions and JSON schema parameter properties recursively.
   - Guarantees byte-identical prefix serialization across requests, unlocking 75%–90% prompt caching discounts across Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, and DeepSeek.
4. **Adaptive Multi-Signal Model Cascading**:
   - Analyzes prompt complexity score (0.0 to 1.0) using code/math indicators, reasoning keywords, turn depth, and tool history.
   - Automatically escalates or downgrades queries to configured model tiers:
     - `tier1`: Fast/Light (complexity <= 0.35, e.g. `gemini-2.5-flash-lite`, `gpt-4o-mini`)
     - `tier2`: Standard (0.35 < complexity <= 0.70, e.g. `gemini-2.5-flash`, `gpt-4o`)
     - `tier3`: Deep Reasoning (complexity > 0.70, e.g. `gemini-2.5-pro`, `claude-3-7-sonnet`, `o3-mini`)
5. **Dynamic Thinking Budget Allocation**:
   - Recommends 0 tokens for Tier 1, 2048 for Tier 2, and 8192 for Tier 3.
6. **FinOps Token & USD Savings Telemetry**:
   - Accessible via `client.getMetrics().llmoMetrics`:
     - `totalOptimizedRequests`
     - `totalTokensSaved`
     - `totalEstimatedUsdSaved`
     - `averageCompressionRatio`
     - `cascadedRequestsCount`

---

## 5. Multi-Agent Swarm & Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Handoff Protocol

SinapsAI provides an in-process Multi-Agent Swarm orchestrator with zero external dependencies (`client.swarm`).

```typescript
const swarm = client.swarm({
  agents: [
    {
      id: 'triage',
      name: 'Triage Agent',
      role: 'Classify user requests and route to specialists',
      instructions: 'Analyze request. If coding needed, transfer to coder. If security, transfer to auditor.',
      handoffTargets: ['coder', 'auditor'],
      model: 'gemini-2.5-flash',
    },
    {
      id: 'coder',
      name: 'Senior Developer',
      role: 'Implements production TypeScript code',
      instructions: 'Write production-grade code. Consult auditor for security reviews.',
      handoffTargets: ['auditor'],
      model: 'claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219',
    },
    {
      id: 'auditor',
      name: 'Security Auditor',
      role: 'Audits vulnerabilities and cryptographic budgets',
      instructions: 'Inspect for security vulnerabilities and verify invariants.',
      model: 'gemini-2.5-pro',
    },
  ],
  defaultAgentId: 'triage',
  maxHandoffs: 5, // Prevents ping-pong recursion loops
});

// Non-streaming execution
const result = await swarm.run('Review my token generation function');
console.log('Final Agent:', result.finalAgentId);
console.log('Result:', result.content);
console.log('Total Swarm Cost:', result.totalCostUsd);

// Real-time streaming events
for await (const event of swarm.runStream('Audit this system')) {
  if (event.type === 'handoff') {
    console.log(`[Handoff]: ${event.fromAgentId} -> ${event.toAgentId} (Reason: ${event.reason})`);
  } else if (event.type === 'text-delta') {
    process.stdout.write(event.delta);
  }
}

// Export open A2A Agent Cards (/.well-known/agent.json spec)
const agentCards = swarm.exportAgentCards();
console.log(JSON.stringify(agentCards, null, 2));
```

---

## 6. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tool Bridge

SinapsAI features a complete in-process MCP v1.x Tool Registry and Autonomous Agent Loop (`client.mcp` and `client.runWithTools`):

```typescript
// 1. Register a tool
client.mcp.registerTool({
  name: 'get_weather',
  description: 'Retrieves current weather conditions for a city',
  inputSchema: {
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      city: { type: 'string', description: 'City name' },
    },
    required: ['city'],
  },
  handler: async ({ city }) => ({
    city,
    temperatureC: 22,
    condition: 'Sunny',
  }),
});

// 2. Autonomous Agent Multi-Step Loop
const result = await client.runWithTools({
  model: 'gemini-2.5-flash',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'What is the weather in Tokyo?' }],
  maxSteps: 5,
  onStep: (step) => {
    console.log(`Step ${step.stepIndex} executed ${step.toolCalls.length} tools`);
  },
});
console.log(result.finalResponse.choices[0].message.content);

// 3. MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 Dispatcher (for external stdio/SSE workers)
const rpcResponse = await client.mcp.handleJsonRpc({
  jsonrpc: '2.0',
  id: 1,
  method: 'tools/call',
  params: {
    name: 'get_weather',
    arguments: { city: 'Jakarta' },
  },
});
```

---

## 7. Vercel AI SDK Adapter (`sinapsai/ai-sdk`)

SinapsAI can be plugged directly into the Vercel AI SDK (`ai`):

```typescript
import { createSinaps } from 'sinapsai/ai-sdk';
import { generateText, streamText } from 'ai';

const sinaps = createSinaps({
  strategy: 'adaptive',
  providers: [
    new GeminiProvider({ apiKey: process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY }),
    new OpenAiProvider({ apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY }),
  ],
});

// LanguageModelV1 integration
const { text } = await generateText({
  model: sinaps.languageModel('gemini-2.5-flash'),
  prompt: 'Write a poem about distributed systems',
});

// EmbeddingModelV1 integration
const embedding = await sinaps.textEmbeddingModel('text-embedding-3-small').doEmbed({
  values: ['Semantic search text'],
});
```
